1: The number $|5-7|-|-3+4|$ equals: A. -3 B. -5 C. 1 D. 3

4: Given the number $x=63^2\cdot\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^4$. Then: A. $x=7^2$ B. $x=7^{-2}$ C. $x=3^8\cdot7^2$ D. $x=3\cdot7$
5: The square of the number $x=5+2\sqrt3$ equals: A. 37 B. $25+4\sqrt3$ C. $37+20\sqrt3$ D. 147
6: The number $\log_5 5-\log_5 125$ equals: A. -2 B. -1 C. $\frac{1}{25}$ D. 4
10: Numbers $x_1$, $x_2$ are the roots of the equation $x^2+10x-24=0$, with $x_1<x_2$. Compute $2x_1+x_2$. A. -22 B. -17 C. 8 D. 13
11: The number 2 is a root of the polynomial $W(x)=x^3+ax^2+6x-4$. The coefficient $a$ equals: A. 2 B. -2 C. 4 D. -4
12: Indicate $m$ for which the linear function $f(x)=(m-1)x+3$ is constant. A. $m=1$ B. $m=2$ C. $m=3$ D. $m=-1$

15: In an arithmetic sequence, $a_1=3$ and $a_{20}=7$. Then the sum $S_{20}=a_1+a_2+\dots+a_{19}+a_{20}$ equals: A. 95 B. 200 C. 230 D. 100
16: The figure shows a right triangle with marked side lengths and angle α (legs 5 and 12, hypotenuse 13; α is at the vertex between the leg of length 12 and the hypotenuse). Then: A. $\cos\alpha=\frac{5}{13}$ B. $\tan\alpha=\frac{13}{12}$ C. $\cos\alpha=\frac{12}{13}$ D. $\tan\alpha=\frac{12}{5}$
18: A vertical pole of height 90 cm casts a shadow 60 cm long. At the same moment a nearby tower casts a shadow 12 m long. What is the height of the tower? A. 18 m B. 8 m C. 9 m D. 16 m
19: Points A, B and C lie on a circle with center S (see figure). The marked central (reflex) angle, on the side of AB not containing C, is 230°. The measure of the marked inscribed angle ACB is: A. 65° B. 100° C. 115° D. 130°
22: Indicate the equation of the axis of symmetry of the parabola $y=x^2-4x+2010$. A. $x=4$ B. $x=-4$ C. $x=2$ D. $x=-2$
23: Angle $\alpha$ is acute and $\cos\alpha=\frac{3}{7}$. Then: A. $\sin\alpha=\frac{2\sqrt{10}}{7}$ B. $\sin\alpha=\frac{\sqrt{10}}{7}$ C. $\sin\alpha=\frac{4}{7}$ D. $\sin\alpha=\frac{3}{4}$
24: The menu has 5 soups and 4 main courses. In how many ways can a meal consisting of one soup and one main course be ordered? A. 25 B. 20 C. 16 D. 9

28: The hypotenuse of a right triangle is longer than one leg by 1 cm and longer than the other leg by 32 cm. Compute the lengths of the sides of this triangle.
31: Compute how many four-digit natural numbers there are in which the first digit is even and the remaining digits are odd.
32: The sequence $(1, x, y-1)$ is arithmetic, while the sequence $(x, y, 12)$ is geometric. Compute $x$ and $y$, and give this geometric sequence.
